05/ 18.09.2023.

Petitioner above-named who is in custody since 10.11.2022 has moved this Court
for grant of regular bail in connection with Katras P.S. Case No.376 of 2022 (G.R. No.271 of 2023 &
S.T. No.214 of 2023) registered under Sections 302/ 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
Heard the parties.

As per the case of prosecution, the deceased was the son of the informant who had love-affair with the daughter of one Prabhu Bhuiya which was not liked by him as he had earlier threatened him with life.
It is alleged that on 08.11.2022, the deceased was called by daughter of Prabhu Bhuiya to her house and after one hour, he was killed and the deadbody was hanged in the courtyard of the house.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the independent witnesses have stated during investigation that deceased was removed to the Hospital where he was found to be alive and was not declared to be dead and thereafter he died in the hospital.
No inquest report has been prepared and he has been implicated in the case only on mere suspicion.
Learned APP for the State has vehemently opposed the prayer.
It is submitted that he is named in the FIR and there is direct and specific allegation that he had threatened the deceased with life on earlier occasion.
It has come in the post-mortem report that the death was caused by strangulation.
Inquest having not been committed will have no bearing on the case, considering the other materials on record.
There is sufficient material to show that the petitioner caused the incidence in the house and thereafter he was taken to the Hospital where he was declared to be dead.
Prabhu Bhuiya vs The State Of Jharkhand.
